GeneralPerks.Name: Acute Senses
GeneralPerks.Text: Choose one of the five senses: (sight,hearing,taste,touch, or smell) You gain the following benefits : An Edge when rolling an Alertness Skill Test for if your chosen sense can be applied. An Upshift on a non-Alertness test where your chosen sense can be applied. You can chooe this Perk up to five times; once for each sense.

GeneralPerks.Name: Additional Alt Mode
GeneralPerks.Text: Choose A chasis Tied to an Origin. You gain the alt mode benefits of that chasis as a second choice when you Convert. You cannot choose a Chassis whose Alt Mode Size is two Size Classes larger than the Alt Mode Size of your orignal Chassis unless you take the Size Change General Perk. When you gain a Perk taht applies to an Alt mode, choose which Alt Mode it applies to when you gain the Perk.

GeneralPerks.Name: All Out Attack
GeneralPerks.Text: During your turn, you can voluntariliy take a downshift on your attacks with Might, Finesse, or targeting. For each downshift you take, you deal 1 additional damage to a single target hit by the attack, but enenemies gain an equal number of Upshifts to attack you until the start of your next turn.

GeneralPerks.Name: All Terrain Alt Mode
GeneralPerks.Text: One of your alt mode can move in different ways. Choose a movement type you do not have access to in your alt mode. You gain that movement of that type 20ft.

GeneralPerks.Name: Always Alert
GeneralPerks.Text: Gain the follwing benefits: 1) You gain an edge when rolling for initiative 2) You can't be suprised while you are concious

GeneralPerks.Name: Bot's Bot'
GeneralPerks.Text: You can use Deception or Persuasion instead of Alertness to determine if someone is lying, disguising intentions, or hiding something. With a success on your skill test you learn an important detail about the character.

GeneralPerks.Name: Cross-Training
GeneralPerks.Text: Choose a Role other than your own. You may select one of that Role's Perks that it gains at a level no higher than half your current level. You cannot choose a Role Perk with the same name as one in you own Role, (for example you may not pick extra attack if your Role offers it.) a Focus Perk, or a Level one Perk. You can Slecect this perk mutlitple times each time picking a differnt Role to gain a perk from.

GeneralPerks.Name: Daredevil
GeneralPerks.Text: Gain the Follwing Traits: 1) Gain an edge on Initiative rolls in an Alt Mode 2) Upshift 2 on Drvining Skill Tests in Alt Mode

GeneralPerks.Name: Dig Deep
GeneralPerks.Text: Gain the following Benefits: 1) Once Per combat you can ignore 1 Damage by taking a Snag on all Skill Tests until the end of your next Turn

GeneralPerks.Name: Dodgy
GeneralPerks.Text: You gain +2 Evasion. Additionally, any turn where you do not move more than 5 feet, you can Defend as a Free action.

GeneralPerks.Name: Durabyllium Super Alloy
GeneralPerks.Text: Gain +2 Toughness. Additionally when an opponent targets you with a Blunt, Cold, or Fire Attack, They suffer a downshift to their attack roll.

GeneralPerks.Name: Earlier is Better than Later
GeneralPerks.Text: While in Alt mode, Free actions used for additoinal Movement add 10 feet to Movement instead of 5. Additionally, Exchanging Free actions for additional Movement is n9t limited

GeneralPerks.Name: Educated
GeneralPerks.Text: Gain the Following Benefits 1) Gain fluenecy in 1 Language of your choice, 2) dd an additioanl Story Point to your Team's poolat the beginning of each game session; 3) Act as though Specialized in a single Smarts Skill, choosen when you take this Perk, once per day.'
